storage_roots_note: local only. No pod volume path exists yet; spec 04 provisions one, and it joins this list only once it does. An unlisted root is refused, never assumed.
logging_rule: a log line may carry counts, digests, geometry and reason codes; it may never carry a declared filename, a declared path, or image bytes
temp_file_handling: every write is a temp file in the same directory, flushed and fsynced, then linked or renamed into place; no temp file survives a completed run or a cleanup pass
retention_and_deletion: testimonia are pipeline records under GOVERNANCE 4 and this policy deletes none of them; working copies and exports follow a retention schedule Tyrel sets per batch; whole-run disposal under GOVERNANCE 4 is a standing open question put to him in the gate package, not resolved here
routing_rule: what produced a file decides where it is stored, never the file's extension
third_party_transmission: sending a real image or a transcription to an external API is disclosure beyond accepted local and volume exposure and requires Tyrel's approval naming the vendor and the pages, recorded as its own approval artifact
cleanup_drill: demonstrated on synthetic material only: target paths absent, temp files absent, logs scanned clean, volume object listing empty where a volume exists; never a claim of forensic unrecoverability from storage media, snapshots, or provider backups
